_comment: Plan 1 PR-1.2 — `any` budget lockfile. Each entry is the maximum number of `\bany\b` occurrences (excluding pure-comment lines, test files) tolerated in that file. Most entries are false positives — `\bany\b` matches the word in string literals (e.g. "no data in any period"), property names (e.g. `saturated.any`), or comments. Real `any` type annotations should be 0. Tighten budgets when content drops; never raise without justification. CI script: scripts/check-any-budget.cjs.
